Layer 2 SolutionsObjective: Achieve scalability and high throughput for smart contract execution using Layer 2 solutions such as zkRollups.Connectivity:Layer 2 Integration: Layer 2 solutions are integrated with Quantum Chain nodes for off-chain transaction processing while maintaining security and decentralization.Deployment and Launch PhasesThe implementation and launch of Quantum Chain and Quantum Coin follow a systematic approach:Quantum Chain Development: Customize the Ethereum fork for Quantum Chain and integrate quantum resistance features, Chainlink, AWS infrastructure, Polygon bridge, and Layer 2 solutions.Quantum Coin Development: Develop Quantum Coin ($Q) following Ethereum token standards with quantum resistance features.Token Distribution: Execute the ICO, allocate tokens, and implement vesting schedules.Integration: Integrate Quantum Coin into the Quantum Chain ecosystem for various purposes, including transaction fees, staking, governance, and rewards.Testing: Thoroughly test Quantum Chain and Quantum Coin for security, scalability, and compatibility.Launch: Deploy Quantum Chain mainnet and Quantum Coin ($Q) to the public.Upon successful completion of the project and launch of the Quantum Chain  and Quantum ($Q) Coin.Please apply with your cv. I currently have a list of about 32 keywords that I am trying to target and I need you to use your preferred tool of choice to write a 1000 - 2000 word entry for each of them. You need to instruct your tool of choice to write the articles in a way that mentions the target keyword as much as possible without compromising on the readability of the article.At the beginning and end of the article, it should also mention the company name that provides the service the article is about and link to its site. All in all, it's a very straightforward process, just automating the writing of content marketing articles. I was doing it myself but it's getting too cumbersome submitting several prompts to ChatGPT 4.0 for each article (as it can't write 2000-3000 word articles in one-go, you have to break them into separate sections and them combine them afterwards).Please also make sure that the articles aren't written too generically. You want part of your prompt engineering to include the act of instructing it to write in a more human manner that will relate to the readers, otherwise it'll just end up writing the articles in a way that is now easily detectable as AI-generated content by most people.I've found that finding content relevant to the keyword online and copy-and-pasting/feeding it the information from those articles makes it so it doesn't give you the most generic information imaginable. You just tell it to then re-write it in a fashion that sounds more human and it will do a relatively good job of that. Then just have it insert the company in one of the paragraphs in the introduction and conclusion. The introduction needs to be subtle and relevant, I do not want the articles coming off as too "salesy".I am looking to pay $3 per finished article and will have probably another couple hundred keywords that I'll need to target in the near future. Assuming you can churn out a finished article every 10-15 minutes like I was doing, this job will be paying about $12-$18 an hour. Send your proposals my way if you are interested.Budget: $100Posted On: February 20, 2024 06:49 UTCCategory: Creative WritingSkills:Content Writing,     Search Engine Optimization,     Article Writing,     English,     Article,     Blog Content,     Writing,     Blog Writing,     SEO WritingSkills:        Content Writing,                     Search Engine Optimization,                     Article Writing,                     English,                     Article,                     Blog Content,                     Writing,                     Blog Writing,                     SEO WritingCountry: United Statesclick to apply

title: Data Analysis
description: Certainly! Data analysis is a process of inspecting, cleaning, transforming, and modeling data with the goal of discovering useful information, drawing conclusions, and supporting decision-making. Here are some key steps and concepts involved in data analysis:1. **Define Objectives:**- Clearly define the goals and objectives of your analysis. What do you want to achieve? What questions are you trying to answer?2. **Data Collection:**- Gather relevant data from various sources. This could be from databases, surveys, sensors, APIs, etc.3. **Data Cleaning:**- Preprocess and clean the data to handle missing values, outliers, and inconsistencies. This step is crucial to ensure the accuracy and reliability of your analysis.4. **Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA):**- Explore the data using descriptive statistics, visualizations, and summary tables to understand its structure, patterns, and relationships. This step helps in generating hypotheses and insights.5. **Data Transformation:**- Transform the data if needed, such as scaling, normalizing, encoding categorical variables, or creating new features.6. **Statistical Analysis:**- Apply statistical methods to test hypotheses, identify patterns, and make inferences about the population based on sample data.7. **Machine Learning:**- Implement machine learning algorithms for predictive modeling or classification tasks, depending on the nature of your analysis.8. **Data Visualization:**- Create visual representations of the data using charts, graphs, and dashboards to communicate insights effectively.9. **Interpretation and Conclusion:**- Draw conclusions from the analysis and interpret the results in the context of your objectives. Communicate findings in a clear and understandable manner.10. **Documentation:**- Document your analysis process, methodologies, and results. This is essential for reproducibility and for others to understand and validate your work.11. **Feedback and Iteration:**- Seek feedback from stakeholders and iterate on your analysis if needed. Continuous improvement is crucial in data analysis.Popular tools for data analysis include Python with libraries like Pandas, NumPy, and Matplotlib, R, and tools like SQL for database queries. Additionally, specialized tools such as Excel, Tableau, and Jupyter Notebooks are commonly used in the field.Hourly Range: $8.00-$12.00Posted On: February 14, 2024 17:39 UTCCategory: Data AnalyticsSkills:Data Analysis,     Microsoft Excel,     Data Entry,     Data Mining,     Data ModelingSkills:        Data Analysis,                     Microsoft Excel,                     Data Entry,                     Data Mining,                     Data ModelingCountry: Pakistanclick to apply

title: BI Analyst / Developer using Lookerstudio and Bigquery
description: We are looking for a business intelligence analyst that can support our team remotely and expand the current BI landscape that is already in place.To select the right candidate we have created a technical challenge designed to assess your skills in Business Intelligence, specifically focusing on analyzing application usage data. This challenge aims to simulate a real-world scenario where you'll be tasked with extracting insights from application usage data to inform business decisions. You will be using Google BigQuery for data analysis and Google Looker Studio for data visualization. This is an opportunity to showcase your ability to work with complex datasets, your analytical thinking, and your proficiency in creating compelling data visualizations.Objective:Your goal is to analyze a dataset representing user interactions with a web application, focusing on user engagement, feature usage, and retention. Using the Google Analytics Sample Dataset for BigQuery, you will derive insights into how users interact with the application, identify patterns, and visualize these insights in a dashboard using Google Looker Studio.Step 1: Data Analysis in BigQuery:- **Dataset:** `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample`- **Tasks:**1. **Calculate Engagement Metrics:** Determine Daily Active Users (DAU) and Monthly Active Users (MAU).2. **Feature Analysis:** Identify the most and least used features by querying event data.3. **Demographic and Cohort Analysis:** Join user demographic information with session data to analyze usage patterns. Perform a cohort analysis based on user signup date to study retention.4. **Advanced Analysis:** Incorporate session duration and time-of-day analysis to explore when users are most active.Step 2: Visualization in Google Looker Studio:- **Objective:** Create a dashboard in Google Looker Studio that clearly presents your findings from BigQuery, including:1. **Engagement Trends:** Visualize DAU and MAU over time.2. **Feature Popularity:** Chart showing feature usage frequency.3. **User Demographics:** Insights into user engagement segmented by demographics.4. **Cohort Retention:** Visualization of retention rates for different cohorts.5. **Interactive Elements:** Ensure the dashboard includes filters or interactive elements for a deeper data dive.Evaluation Criteria:- **SQL Proficiency:** Complexity and efficiency of SQL queries.- **Analytical Skills:** Ability to extract meaningful insights from complex data.- **Visualization Expertise:** Clarity and effectiveness of the dashboard in communicating insights.- **Data Storytelling:** Competence in narrating a data-driven story that supports business decisions.Dataset Access:- Access the dataset directly in Google Cloud's BigQuery under `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample`.- Use standard SQL in the BigQuery console for analysis.Submission Requirements:- Provide SQL queries used for the analysis.- Share a link to the Looker Studio dashboard.- Include a brief report summarizing key insights and potential recommendations for improving user engagement and retention.Timeframe:- The challenge is designed to be completed within 1-2 hours.- We will not be able to review the results until Wed. 28th FebThis technical challenge is an opportunity to demonstrate your ability to work with real-world data, using advanced SQL queries and data visualization tools to drive business intelligence insights. title: PHP Core Application Migration: Firebase Legacy API to HTTPv1
description: I am seeking a skilled developer to undertake the migration of a PHP application from Firebase's deprecated legacy API to the HTTPv1 API. This application serves as a central hub for sending post notifications across diverse platforms including Facebook, Google, Fireways, Android, and Chrome. The current codebase is predominantly in native PHP, representing a custom-built solution tailored to our specific needs.The task at hand involves a multi-faceted approach to ensure a seamless transition. Primarily, the developer will need to update the API integration to align with Firebase's HTTPv1 specifications. This includes revising the authentication mechanism, transitioning from the legacy keys system to proper authentication methods prescribed by Firebase. Furthermore, adjustments to the payload structure will be necessary to accommodate the requirements of each platform supported by the application.Upon completion of the migration, thorough testing is imperative to validate the application's functionality across all platforms. This testing phase encompasses rigorous checks to ensure that notifications are successfully sent and received as intended. Any anomalies or issues discovered during testing must be promptly addressed to guarantee a smooth user experience post-migration.Scope of Work:1. Update the PHP application to utilize Firebase's HTTPv1 API for push notifications.2. Revise the authentication mechanism to comply with Firebase's authentication requirements for HTTPv1.3. Customize the payload structure to suit the specifications of each platform supported by the application (e.g., Android, Chrome).4. Conduct comprehensive testing to validate the functionality of the application post-migration.5. Address and resolve any issues or discrepancies discovered during testing to ensure seamless notification delivery.Links:Base Application: [URL] Firebase Doc: [URL] Migration Doc: [URL] Fully migrated PHP application seamlessly integrated with Firebase's HTTPv1 API.2. Detailed documentation outlining the changes made during the migration process, including instructions for future maintenance and updates.3. Comprehensive test results confirming the application's functionality across all supported platforms post-migration.Expectations:The ideal candidate will possess expertise in PHP development, with a strong understanding of API integrations and migration processes. They should demonstrate proficiency in working with Firebase APIs and be able to navigate the intricacies of transitioning from legacy systems to modern protocols. Effective communication throughout the migration process is crucial, as is the ability to deliver a fully functional application within the agreed-upon timeframe.This project offers an opportunity to contribute to the optimization and future-proofing of a critical application infrastructure, ensuring continued reliability and performance in delivering post notifications across various platforms.Please clarify the following questions:1. Can you discuss your experience with PHP development and working on custom-built applications?2. How would you approach updating the authentication mechanism in the PHP application to align with Firebase's HTTPv1 requirements?3. What testing methodologies do you typically employ to ensure the functionality and reliability of applications post-migration?4. What is your experience with Firebase APIs, and can you provide an example of how you've utilized them in previous projects?5. Can you provide an example of a challenge you encountered while working with Firebase APIs in a previous project and how you addressed it?These questions aim to evaluate the candidate's technical proficiency, problem-solving skills, and familiarity with Firebase, ensuring they are well-equipped to handle the requirements of the migration project effectively.Please Note: Apps using deprecated FCM legacy APIs for HTTP and XMPP must migrate to HTTP v1 API soon.
